items.title: Evan Christopher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 1, 2009
items.q: players like Sidney Bechet and Omer Simeon

ctx.x: Yeah. He wouldn’t worry so much.
So the theoretical parts of learning music stuff, did that help you or hinder you in understanding what players like Sidney Bechet —

Oh, no, it completely helped. It completely helped. Yeah. Even later, there were holes. If I had learned more, for instance, about analysis. If I had learned more about how to break performance practice down into elements. If I had learned more about how to organize and identify schemas and protocol for performing the music, which comes through study of — I think comes from formal study of European classical music and the types of courses that I guess I would have had access to if I’d continued music education or…
